Results.ReviewText: Very well built, great instructions, and cooks as it should! The ash cleaner bin is a great feature
Results.Title: Solid grill

Results.ReviewText: I am falling in love with charcoal grilling after years of using propane. The flavor just does not compare between the two types of grilling. I'm having a bit of a learning curve with maintaining the charcoal so there is consistent heat across the grill and the Original Kettle makes experimentation easier. I'm glad I bought this Weber to reacquaint myself with charcoal grilling.
Results.Title: Great Sturdy Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: If you're going to own just one grill, this is the one. Well built, simple to use and so versitle. Hot and fast, low and slow, smoke, you name it and there's a way to do it on the Weber Kettle!
Results.Title: The Best Low Cost Grill Out There

ClientResponses.Response: Thank you for your feedback. We are so sorry to learn of your disappointment with the quality of the grill. Rest assured your grill comes with a generous warranty and we will always stand behind our products if anything goes wrong. Our Support will be reaching out to see how we can assist you further. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber Grills

Results.ReviewText:
I have purchased upwards of five grills over the last 20 years.
They have steadily gotten cheaper in quality  and more flimsy.
I get you want to protect your price point, but maybe a retro offering might be an interesting idea.
Results.Title: product quality has declined

Results.ReviewText:
Excellent! 
I recommend the add-on for the charcoal that make the work more easy.
Results.Title: General use.

Results.ReviewText: Love the ash catch feature.  Copper color of grill is nice too.  Grilling is great with good heat distribution and space within the grill.
Results.Title: New Weber Owner

Results.ReviewText:
I'm the griller in our household because my husband likes to put meat on cold grates and flips meat too often. I like that the lid has a place to hang on the grill so you don't set it on the floor and burn your leg on the lid because you forgot it was hot.

Wouldn't trade my grill for another. And it's green too!
Results.Title: Great standard charcoal grill!

Results.ReviewText: After researching, reading BBQ forums and talking to a few serious grill users, I chose the Weber kettle grill and I have no regrets! I’ve had it about a month, and grilled over a dozen times. I really like it, and I feel like it’s gonna last a while. Also, the customer service is great!
Results.Title: Love my new Weber!!!

Results.ReviewText: I completely enjoy this grill but have had little time to use it.
Results.Title: Weber is always dependable

Results.ReviewText: Love the new Indigo Blue Kettle I got at Ace Hardware and love that its a Limited Release. I wanted a new Kettle to go along with a black one I found years ago abandoned on the curb that I restored. Now I have two .
Results.Title: Indigo Blue Weber Kettle from Ace Hardware.

Results.ReviewText: Outstanding Charcoal Grill.  Very east to clean.  I have used it only a few times.  I cannot wait to try and smoke a pork butt on it.
Results.Title: Outstanding Charcoal Grill

Results.ReviewText: Can't go wrong with the Weber Kettle. I cook on it every weekend and occasionally during the week. I have purchase other grills but I will never be without a Weber.
Results.Title: Old Trustee

Results.ReviewText: Fantastic kettle grill for hardwood and traditional briquette use. Large enough for use as a smoker with the fire baskets and perforated foil containers. The ash container and clearing system work flawlessly and is simple and easy to empty.
Results.Title: Best grill I've owned

Results.ReviewText: I've had a Kettle since 2008. I'm on my second one after the first one gave me 11 great years of grilling on an at least weekly basis in the Florida weather. My next one is on its 3rd year of life and isn't slowing down. Its finish still looks good, no rust anywhere, and it still sees grilling on a weekly basis. I can't recommend it enough.
Results.Title: 14 years of Kettle and counting

Results.ReviewText: This is my third Weber Kettle; I just rebuilt #2 to use as a dedicated smoker  (with built up tar on the inside lid).  #3 is the pretty copper one that will be used for grilling for company or picnics. I also have a pellet smoker but the smoke flavor from it is not as intense as I get with charcoal with wood chips/chunks. #3 is my first with the pot style ash catcher and it is great!. #2 has a frisbee style catcher that I have to chain down in the winter and spring to keep it from flying. When I lived out on a potato farm, the first frisbee style ash catcher on #2 flew away and was not found again!.
Results.Title: Everybody Needs Two Webers on Their Patio

Results.ReviewText: I absolutely love cooking on the Weber Kettle, and my new, premium copper version is beautiful. Using the chimney for starting coals, baskets for indirect cooking and BBQ wood for extra flavor, Weber makes grilling fun and the food taste's great. My Weber is literally the gold standard.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle is the gold standard

Results.ReviewText: I’m 67 years old now. When my children were teens they bought me a Weber 22” for Father’s Day and I used it for many years (about 15 to 20). After blowing over in storms and being left outside all winter, it needed replacing. Over the next 20+ years I tried several other styles and models. But I missed my Weber 22” grill. So this spring I bought a new one.
Results.Title: Back to Proven Ability

Results.ReviewText: I love this charcoal grill! Easy to use. Easy to clean. Love the taste of charcoal vs. propane. Excited to try different recipes
Results.Title: Kettle premium grill worth every penny

Results.ReviewText:
Guys, if you want to get a starter charcoal grill and are afraid that its going to be hard. Stop overthinking it. this is one of the easiest to manage. after a few mods, seen on YouTube with a liner and adding of a thermometer in the right position, this is the best. 

For short and searing heat to long and slow cooks. I have a Weber Genesis propane as well, but if you are looking to get that coal flavor, look no further.
Results.Title: A must have in your backyard

Results.ReviewText: If the dome damper had a cool touch handle it would be perfect.
Results.Title: Great and versatile

Results.ReviewText: So for it is great, quantity of the grill is very good
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: A nice grill overall, but quality is less than the one I’m replacing from 2001.  I sure hope I get 21 years out of this one as well, only time will tell.
Results.Title: Overall a good grill - not as good as prior ones

Results.ReviewText: The Weber Kettle works great for direct and indirect grilling.  I have smoked chicken and a pork shoulder and it is awesome!!
Results.Title: Weber Copper

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble…product is tried & true…been around for years…best quality for the price…will last forever
Results.Title: Weber-Quality and Craftsmanship and Timelessness

Results.ReviewText: Bought another kettle to replace the one I gave away when I moved and it’s still a great product. Got the copper color and it looks awesome. Easy ash management and the best all around grill/smoker for the price. My lid doesn’t seal as well as ones I’ve had in the past causing smoke to leave without heading over to the vent, but I’ll try and seal it up some how. No biggie, just seems to be a little out of round
Results.Title: Long Time Weber Owner

Results.ReviewText: Actually the first Weber I've ever owned. I was going to buy an Old Smokey, which I've had in the past but decided to spend the extra money. So far so good. Good quality and easy cleaning. Love the bottom attachment that catches all the ash.
Results.Title: Great Charcoal grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill is all you’ll ever need. No reason to try anything else. I’ve only owned Weber charcoal grills and they’ve never let me down.
Results.Title: Tried and tested

Results.ReviewText: Got this for my hubby for his birthday. He will only use a Weber grill. He is thrilled and has cooked on it every night!
Results.Title: Best Birthday present 2vwr!

Results.ReviewText: After the very first use I noticed that there were rust spots beginning to form on the cover.
Results.Title: disappointment

Results.ReviewText:
Nice grill, definitely heats up quickly. Wish I would have gotten a Weber years ago. I
Yes this grill is more expensive but it’s worth it.
Results.Title: My New Weber Kettle Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Bought last month. Easy to assemble and nice size grill. Great looking copper colour.

Suggestions: Add a fourth leg instead of three.
Results.Title: Original Kettle Premium Charcoal 22”

Results.ReviewText: Upgraged from the Jumbo Joe. I have this unit in Copper! It's so beautiful. Like a new penny! The hinged cooking grates are wonderful, I do a lot of indirect cooking. Plenty of room for my steak, veggies, chicken and more. The ash catcher and one touch cleaning are as refreshing as a cool breeze on a hot day.
Results.Title: Such a wonderful Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I hadn't cooked with a charcoal grille in over twenty years, but found this one so easy to use once again.
Results.Title: Very Much Pleased With It........

Results.ReviewText: If I had to do it again I would buy the unhinged lid master touch.I do love my kettle for its versatility.
Results.Title: Love my kettle

Results.ReviewText: I bought this BBQ because I wanted to cook with charcoal.  This BBQ is built to last.  The flavors you get when cooking with this BBQ are insane!!!  I will never go back to propane again!
Results.Title: Built to last!

Results.ReviewText: I was already a fan of Weber grills (40+ years). The improvements to the original kettle grill in the ash handling and bottom venting make an already great grill really fantastic!  Our old, original kettle grill is still in use at our son’s house - they are STURDY!  The addition of a rotisserie only adds to the fun.
Results.Title: Great product gets even better!

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
